where it all started
our story
“My story with lactation cookies started when my friend started struggling with breastfeeding her newborn.”

At the time, we had no choice but to start making lactation cookies ourselves, praying that it would work for the sake of her baby and amazingly, it did! These cookies helped her milk supply almost immediately and I was so grateful to have been able to make her early motherhood days just a bit easier.
Now I hope that I can do the same thing for you. Using natural, wholesome ingredients, everything is made with care and intention for breastfeeding mums and their new beautiful babies.
Zainab x

attributes.title: Are they OK to eat while breastfeeding?

attributes.text: They’re made from everyday food ingredients. Fenugreek isn’t right for everyone, so if you or your baby are sensitive to it, or you have a health condition, check with your midwife or GP first.
Build your box and choose every 2 or 4 weeks. You get 10% off every box and free delivery on 20 and 40 packs. Skip, swap flavours or cancel online whenever you like.
Oats (gluten), eggs, milk and fenugreek, a legume that may cross-react with peanut or soy allergies. Made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts. The vegan base has no eggs or dairy.
